title: What a door popper is
summary: A door popper is a gossip who peeps through windows and doors.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers

blocks.x: Well, they have the Cozy Corner door poppers. Tell them what a door popper is.
Oh, door popper. Door popper. Just people like to peep through the windows and doors and interfere with other people's business. And, you know, just bad. Like a peep in town.
Like a gossip. You know women that gossip, you know?
I hope you're better than that. Gossip, yeah.
